field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this AmneziaWG tunnel

field.label: Name
field.help: Alphanumeric name for the tunnel, max 15 chars

field.label: Interface Number
field.help: Interface suffix number (0-99), must be unique per tunnel. Interface will be named awg{N}.

field.label: Endpoint
field.help: Server address and port, e.g. 1.2.3.4:51820

field.label: Private Key
field.help: Your private key. Use the Generate Keypair button below to create a new one.

field.label: Tunnel Address
field.help: Interface address assigned by the server, e.g. 10.8.1.2/24

field.label: DNS
field.help: DNS servers (comma-separated). Leave empty to use OPNsense Unbound.

field.label: Listen Port
field.help: Local UDP port (optional, leave empty for random)

field.label: MTU
field.help: Leave empty for default (1420). Reduce to 1280-1380 if experiencing issues.

field.label: Jc
field.help: Number of junk packets before each handshake (1-128). From server config.

field.label: Jmin
field.help: Minimum junk packet size in bytes. From server config.

field.label: Jmax
field.help: Maximum junk packet size in bytes. From server config.

field.label: S1
field.help: Extra bytes added before init message. From server config.

field.label: S2
field.help: Extra bytes added before response message. From server config.

field.label: S3
field.help: AWG 2.0: extra bytes added before cookie message (0-1280). From server config.

field.label: S4
field.help: AWG 2.0: extra bytes added before transport data message (0-1280). From server config.

field.label: H1
field.help: Header ID for init packets — number or range (e.g. 12345 or 12345-67890), values 5-4294967295. Ranges must not overlap with H2/H3/H4. Leave empty, or set 1, when the server does not obfuscate headers. From server config.

field.label: H2
field.help: Header ID for response packets — number or range (e.g. 12345 or 12345-67890), values 5-4294967295. Ranges must not overlap with H1/H3/H4. Leave empty, or set 2, when the server does not obfuscate headers. From server config.

field.label: H3
field.help: Header ID for cookie packets — number or range (e.g. 12345 or 12345-67890), values 5-4294967295. Ranges must not overlap with H1/H2/H4. Leave empty, or set 3, when the server does not obfuscate headers. From server config.

field.label: H4
field.help: Header ID for data packets — number or range (e.g. 12345 or 12345-67890), values 5-4294967295. Ranges must not overlap with H1/H2/H3. Leave empty, or set 4, when the server does not obfuscate headers. From server config.

field.label: I1
field.help: CPS init packet template using tags: <b 0xHEX> <r N> <rd N> <rc N> <t> <c>. From server config.

field.label: I2
field.help: CPS packet 2 template. Ignored if I1 is empty. From server config.

field.label: I3
field.help: CPS packet 3 template. Ignored if I1 is empty. From server config.

field.label: I4
field.help: CPS packet 4 template. Ignored if I1 is empty. From server config.

field.label: I5
field.help: CPS packet 5 template. Ignored if I1 is empty. From server config.

field.label: Header Protection Key
field.help: 32-byte Base64 key. Required when the server profile uses AWG3 header protection.

field.label: Content Padding Addition
field.help: AWG3 padding range in bytes, for example 2-10.

field.label: Rekey After Time
field.help: AWG3 rekey interval in seconds or range, for example 110-120.

field.label: Rekey Timeout
field.help: AWG3 handshake retry timeout in seconds or range.

field.label: Reject After Time
field.help: AWG3 peer rejection interval in seconds or range.

field.label: Keepalive Timeout
field.help: AWG3 keepalive timeout in seconds or range.

field.label: Max Handshake Attempts
field.help: AWG3 maximum handshake attempts in a number or range.

field.label: Random Trailers
field.help: Enable AWG3 random transport trailers.

field.label: Disable Cookies
field.help: Disable AWG3 cookie replies when required by the server profile.

field.label: Public Key
field.help: Server public key. From server config.

field.label: Pre-Shared Key
field.help: Optional pre-shared key for additional security.

field.label: Allowed IPs
field.help: Use 0.0.0.0/0 to route all traffic through the tunnel.

field.label: Keepalive
field.help: Send keepalive every N seconds (e.g. 25). Required when behind NAT.
